description: Grounded physical camera directions for every narration line. Reviewed remains false until a human checks the generated clips.

intro.action: Same fixed steel-blue sedan drives through moonlit fog on a deserted highway; rolling wheels and moving lane stripes show motion, while headlights visibly flicker at 2:47 AM
The sedan engine coughs; headlights pulse, tires decelerate and the vehicle shudders to a complete stop on the shoulder
Camera inside same sedan: Max twists ignition key; dashboard illumination dies; Biscuit trembles on passenger seat
Max takes his backpack, opens the same car door, exits onto deserted highway and turns on a handheld flashlight; Biscuit follows
Over Max's flashlight shoulder the distant gas station alone remains brightly lit through haze
Max holds his flashlight toward station glass door as human-like shadow slides behind it; Biscuit recoils
Close view of locked station glass door vibrating with three knocks, door handle slowly turning on its spindle with nobody outside

store_sound.action: Max and Biscuit circle around back of the gas station and locate an unlocked steel loading entrance; Max opens it and slips inside as the knocking ends
Tracking aisle shot of Max scanning real stocked food cans water bottles and batteries while Biscuit sniffs shelves
The locked STAFF ONLY door behind the counter shudders and heavy dragging movement casts a shadow along the floor; Max turns
Max crouches beside piled canned food; Biscuit freezes; the stockroom's unseen threat presses against the door
Split tactical view of Max facing exit route and dark stockroom door while both choices remain physically visible

run_away.action: Max moves slowly backward from the supply shelves as Biscuit shadows his legs, careful not to knock any cans
Staff door handle twists; Max grabs Biscuit and sprints out the actual glass front entrance
Max enters the same blue-grey sedan, turns the key twice; dashboard and headlights come on, the car pulls away
From the driver's road perspective Ada waves frantically in roadside fog holding a radio; Max sees her and brakes
Ada opens passenger door and climbs into sedan; the vehicle drives past a glowing roadside motel sign at sunrise

check_back.action: Max grips a metal tire iron while Biscuit stays back; his shaking hand reaches for staff door
Inside cramped storeroom Ada crouches behind stacked wooden crates clutching a visible box cutter, Max entering frame
Ada points the box cutter toward Max and speaks; both are frozen as shadows loom beyond the store window
Close action: Max drops tire iron to tile floor, Ada lowers the cutter and looks at vehicle keys in Max's palm
Ada shows Max her shortwave radio inside open utility bag; food crates behind them establish supplies

motel_arrive.action: Blue sedan and companions arrive at roadside motel; wide reveal of exactly twelve doors and one rusted truck in parking lot
Max notices flickering VACANCY neon sign reflected in his eyes as the deserted motel stretches behind him
Max Ada and Biscuit enter motel room number six; Max shuts lock and Ada draws curtains in continuous action
Biscuit curls against room door with ears pricked while Max and Ada rest on nearby beds
Wall clock advances to 3:04 AM; outside room six a long dark shadow passes beneath the door

motel_door.action: Close-up of motel room six wooden door as deep scratch marks visibly appear while Biscuit raises his head
A vulnerable unseen person whispers from the other side; door's chain vibrates as Max approaches but stays shut
Max peers through visibly damaged peephole, cannot see beyond; subtle silhouette crosses hallway
Ada visibly grips box cutter while Biscuit bares teeth toward the locked door
Max's hand hovers beside deadbolt; alternate view shows dark barricade and waiting dog

open_door.action: Max unlocks motel door and pulls soaked older trucker Otto into room; rain droplets trail off his heavy jacket
Otto shows weathered mountain road map on table; Max listens while Ada watches
Close-up of dark bite-mark bruise on Otto's arm as he pulls jacket sleeve over it; Max notices
Max drives the same blue-grey sedan through night road with Otto asleep and Max glancing at rearview mirror

stay_quiet.action: Max Ada and Biscuit crouch motionless in motel room; outside scratching changes to heavy knocking on the wooden door
Max braces against wooden dresser and pushes it physically across floor to barricade the motel door
At sunrise Max opens barricade a crack and sees deserted corridor; deep gouges and distinct handprint mark the door
Max Ada and Biscuit leave motel parking lot quickly past office refrigerator door, choosing not to retrieve food

route_pick.action: Max points to a printed road map with radio tower 90 km north; two contrasting routes are traced
Forest shortcut reveal: blue sedan at edge of narrow fogbound dirt road beneath dense branches, broken signal display
Open highway detour reveal: overturned evacuated cars and abandoned town visible on distant road
From road fork Max and Ada face physical signs FOREST and HIGHWAY as Biscuit waits

forest_road.action: Ada drives blue-grey sedan into narrow forest road; windshield wipers clear fog and Max sits in passenger seat
Headlights reveal silhouettes of standing infected figures in heavy roadside fog, arms drooping
Biscuit growls low in back seat; Max strokes his head and signals quiet while Ada grips steering wheel
Sedan crawls past unmoving figures; one zombie's head turns toward passing headlights while the wheels roll
Rear view of moving vehicle receding into fog as roadside zombie silhouettes fade behind it

highway_road.action: Max drives the sedan along unnervingly empty highway; lane signs and poles glide past moving windows
Car stops before bridge completely blocked by abandoned vehicles bumper-to-bumper; companions exit
Max Ada and Biscuit weave between stopped cars; one car alarm flashes and sounds violently
Across bridge dozens of zombies surge toward flashing car alarm and turn in their direction
Max Ada and Biscuit sprint beyond last vehicle as horde follows into highway distance

tower_arrive.action: At dusk the survivors approach isolated elevated lookout tower standing in sparse wilderness
Max touches steel chain wrapped through door handles at tower base; Ada points out chain fastened from inside
Small lantern glides behind high tower window as radio crackles and characters look up
Max looks between calling toward tower window and climbing a narrow exposed exterior ladder

call_out.action: Max cups hands toward lookout tower and shouts; Biscuit barks as his echo rolls through night forest
Silent tower window glows as a real lantern crosses it from inside
From lit upper window woman Mara directs Max and Ada toward entrance; both lower weapon and approach light
Inside tower radio room Mara unfolds detailed forest map in front of Max and Ada, meeting her visibly
Mara tunes a tabletop radio; signal voice announces eastbound convoy and a lit coast route on map

climb_up.action: Max climbs narrow rusty ladder rung by rung while camera tracks upward and wind shakes metal structure
Inside tower top room an empty chair stands beside cold coffee mug under lone electrical lamp
Max freezes as shadow creeps behind his back while a low hungry growl rises
Infected ranger in recognizable forest ranger vest staggers out of shadows reaching toward Max
Max swings brown backpack against infected ranger then snatches handheld radio and canned beans from desk

broadcast.action: Max turns actual radio tuning dials and hears static transform into two distinct voices
Radio speaker crackles as map highlights convoy route east to the sea beside model boat
Ada points to distant illuminated dead city on map while a different voice warns about outbreak origin
Max faces map marking COAST and CITY; corresponding distant scenery visible through tower window

end_coast.action: Wide coastal survivor convoy: exactly four trucks, one boat and a crowd gather as Max Ada Biscuit arrive
Children laugh as Biscuit's tan ears flop; portable generator powers warm food stall in safe camp
Max sleeps in sheltered tent beside Biscuit at dusk, body finally relaxed
Coastal portable radio crackles with voice saying Max's name, camera slowly moves into radio speaker
Max silhouettes against sunset beside boat while distant city radio tower blinks across water

end_city.action: Max steers blue-grey sedan east while Ada watches horizon and Biscuit sits safely on passenger seat
Camera from advancing car reveals ruined city towers and a single lit window
Survivors park outside research laboratory where front entry door hangs visibly open
Inside lab Max and Ada see note-covered walls, empty animal cages and an active tape recorder
Max stares at running laboratory recorder as city light flickers through broken window

intro.action: Max Ada and Biscuit walk carefully through abandoned city street with wind blowing loose papers
Camera follows beam from radio tower on tall brick building beyond collapsed roadway full of cars
Ada unfolds detailed city map on car hood and points to metro tunnel and surface street routes
Biscuit sniffs dust-laden air then recoils at unseen threat while Max crouches beside him

pick.action: View down long empty metro tunnel with tracks leading toward research lab and darkness beyond
Street-level camera reveals open intersections without hiding places and distant infected figures
Max stands at subway stairs facing one route and exposed street sign pointing other route

metro_run.action: Max Ada Biscuit creep into metro tunnel; paw nails and footfalls echo along rails
Dark infected silhouettes shuffle through tunnel lights far ahead as Max hides behind pillar
Ada pushes a rusty metal service door open; hinges visibly scrape and vibrate
Group slips through and shuts metal door as one loud impact dents it from the far side

street_run.action: Survivors step gingerly around broken glass scattered across silent wide city street
An unattended shopping cart rolls across pavement and twelve infected figures simultaneously turn toward it
Max Ada and Biscuit break into full sprint with dog pulling ahead around street wreckage
Ada physically kicks research laboratory entry door inward then slams it behind group

lab_inside.action: Max Ada enter cold lab with empty cages and note-covered walls while radio plays from table
Lab wall speaker hisses with inviting voice as a locked upper-floor door clicks
Ada whispers and raises finger toward stairs; Biscuit stares at upper level in fear
Max examines stairwell and nearby can of flammable lamp oil while weighing visible alternatives

end_truth.action: Max and Ada reach upstairs room and find Dr Wren surrounded by maps showing outbreak spread
Dr Wren opens secured sample cabinet and gestures to labelled vials from day zero
Dr Wren points at outbreak warning map as emergency laboratory lights flash
Max looks toward Ada and Biscuit; they clasp hands then face lab doorway together
Silhouettes of three survivors stand before sunrise outside laboratory, camera pulls back

end_burn.action: Max pours lamp oil along laboratory staircase and ignites trail; flames climb wooden stairs as group withdraws safely
Max Ada Biscuit walk away from smoke tower rising over deserted city rooftops
Ada and Max speak quietly while walking along abandoned farmland at city edge
Group discovers farmhouse beside river; porch, working well, and empty paddock are all visible
Max and Biscuit sit on wooden porch watching dawn as smoke disappears beyond tree line

arrival.action: Max Ada and Biscuit approach fenced riverside settlement as sunrise begins behind water
Radio crackles inside barn; Ada hears her name, looks toward farmhouse window and draws nearer
Max kneels beside open wooden gate to inspect two clear trails of muddy footprints leading apart

gate.action: Porch bulb flickers exactly twice over weathered farmhouse then turns completely off
Biscuit growls at fence while Max inspects fresh muddy footprints beside rusted gate

porch.action: Stranger woman opens porch door only a narrow crack with security chain still hooked in place
Female stranger denies recognizing group while radio nearby audibly repeats their names
Close-up of radio dial indicating old bridge watchtower as exterior road map transitions to bridge scenery

tracks.action: Max examines dark muddy trail with visible oil stain, scattered straw and tread marks
Across river Ada spots blinking signal light attached to bridge railing and points it out

barn.action: Max reads warning scratched into wooden barn plank spelling DO NOT TRUST THE RADIO
Biscuit sniffs abandoned blanket and half-eaten meal beside still-warm campfire
Ada lifts blanket to uncover paper map with one safe highway route marked in red

bridge_watch.action: Survivors cross deserted bridge toward unattended walkie-talkie broadcasting from concrete railing
Close-up of radio display showing tomorrow's date, a precise blue-grey sedan description and repeating message
Max looks along highway where distant survivor silhouettes stand beside abandoned cars at sunset

radio.action: Radio in cabin clears from static to human voice as Ada and Max stop tuning
Tower beacon suddenly turns on despite visible broken power line as Biscuit reacts

signal.action: Max deliberately radios false location; receiver clicks off before sentence finishes
On highway one car honks then three more abandoned cars flash their headlights and horns
From settlement hill Ada and Max see approaching lights; two escape roads split beneath them

tower_watch.action: Max and Ada inspect transmitter attached to old car battery by exposed power leads
Ada opens worn logbook showing identical handwritten KEEP MOVING messages on many dated pages
Over river Max sights two divergent roads each marked by different distant beacon lights

leader.action: Ada folds map beside same parked blue-grey sedan while Biscuit sits alert by front wheel
Max Ada and Biscuit see zombie horde advancing toward river as radio points to dangerous city route
